divergences: Host interface framing: Impl 1 commits a concrete AXI4-Stream/PCIe protocol (64-bit beats, 4 coeffs/beat, 14b→16b padding); Impl 2 drops the host interface entirely as functionally irrelevant — spec flags it as reproduction-invented with no defined protocol.
BRAM depth per bank: Impl 1 explicitly chose 128 words/bank over the spec's flagged 256-vs-128 inconsistency; Impl 2 does not pin a depth — spec leaves the primitive sizing unresolved.

Both impls had to invent the per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s from their own XOR-fold map rather than from the spec — the actual conflict-free map is absent, so any two reconstructions could differ.
Per-state cycle latencies beyond the aggregate 9-cycle lane are reconstructed independently (treated as structural assertions, not derived from spec).

structural_findings: The paper's defining contribution — the conflict-free (bank,offset) map and per-stage crossbar permutation — is replaced by a generic XOR-fold stand-in in both impls, so the architecture is functionally equivalent but structurally not the CFNTT scheme.
Twiddle-reuse rearranged-loop addressing (a memory-footprint optimization) is absent; impls use standard bit-reversed ROM tables, diverging from the reference's reuse loop.
Bit-reversal-free, natural-order datapath claimed by the paper is not realized — bit-reversed twiddle layout reintroduces the reordering the paper eliminates.
Radix-4 fusion of lane-pairs and symmetric-operator hardware sharing exist only as op-count assertions, not as the structural datapath the reference describes.

summary: Reproducibility is bounded by the spec withholding the paper's headline contribution: the exact conflict-free (bank,offset)/crossbar map and the twiddle-reuse loop addressing are flagged source-missing, so both engineers fell back to the same generic XOR-fold and bit-reversed-ROM stand-ins (the functional NTT core, by contrast, is fully pinned and both impls converge on it). Fidelity is solid on every recoverable parameter (N, q=12289, 14-bit, 8 BU, Barrett, psi/omega/Ninv, op-count reductions all match) but weak on the system's identity: the conflict-free mapping and no-bit-reversal/natural-order structure — the very things that make this CFNTT rather than a generic radix-2/4 NTT — are unverifiable or violated in both implementations.
guessed: Negacyclic NTT butterfly convention -> merged psi-twist Cooley-Tukey (DIT) forward, Gentleman-Sande (DIF) inverse, Longa-Naehrig style, bit-reversed twiddle table (spec marks the exact f(stage,block) as source-missing)
Twiddle ROM addressing -> T[k]=psi^bitrev10(k); standard bit-reversed layout (paper's rearranged-loop reuse addressing is source-missing)
Conflict-free bank map -> XOR-fold b(i)=(i&7)^((i>>3)&7)^((i>>6)&7)^((i>>9)&7), offset o(i)=i>>3 (paper's Sec.III map is source-missing; this is a committed stand-in)
Per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s -> the permutation induced by the XOR-fold map (paper's exact table not transcribed)
Radix-4 fused butterfly equations -> spec-provided y0..y3 with b'=W1*x1,c'=W2*x2,d'=W3*x3,j=psi^512; two-stage radix-2 decomposition with twiddles (W2,W2),(W1,j*W1) derived by me
BRAM depth -> 128 words/bank = N/banks (spec notes a 256-vs-128 inconsistency; chose 128)
Host PCIe/DMA framing -> AXI4-Stream valid/ready, 64-bit beats, 4 coeffs/beat, 14b padded to 16b (spec says reproduction-invented, paper has no host interface)
Exact FSM transition table -> minimal IDLE->LOAD->RUN_STAGES->(SCALE_INTT if INTT)->DRAIN->DONE->IDLE reconstruction (paper FSM not extractable)
Barrett correction depth -> up to 2 conditional subtracts for x<q^2 (spec states 2)
modulus q -> 12289 (spec: paper gives only '14-bit NTT-friendly prime'; q=12289 is a reproduction fix)

Forward NTT / inverse INTT concrete algorithm -> standard merged-negacyclic Cooley-Tukey (DIT, forward) + Gentleman-Sande (DIF, inverse) pair with bit-reversed twiddle tables (spec pins only 'DIT, merged psi-twist'; ordering/structure chosen)
Twiddle ROM addressing under the 'rearranged reuse loop' -> standard bit-reversed psi-power table T[k]=psi^bitrev10(k) (spec marks the paper's f(stage,block) source-missing)
Conflict-free bank map -> committed XOR-fold bank(i)=(i&7)^((i>>3)&7)^((i>>6)&7)^((i>>9)&7), offset=i>>3 (spec marks the paper's Sec.III map source-missing)
Radix-4 DIT butterfly equations -> y=DFT4(x0,W1x1,W2x2,W3x3) with j=psi^512 the order-4 rotator (taken verbatim from config_radix_selector spec)
Barrett correction depth -> at most 2 conditional subtractions for x<q^2 (spec states max 2)
Top-level FSM -> IDLE->LOAD->RUN_STAGES->(SCALE_INTT for INTT)->DRAIN->DONE->IDLE (spec's reconstructed minimal table)
Host PCIe/DMA framing -> ignored for functional model (spec itself flags it as reproduction-invented, not a paper claim)
Cycle/latency accounting (9-cycle lane, 64/32 issue cycles) -> treated as structural assertions only, not simulated timing
